set.body: Expose deterministic inspection before and after execution. A plan explanation should report root and target domains, selections and demand, chosen route, inverse qualities, compiler plugins, fusion decisions or barriers, predicted source support, sampling policy, and cache identities; evaluated results should retain route and operator provenance plus coverage and applicable QC. Acceptance: explanation performs no IO or evaluation unless explicitly asked to preflight a source; semantically identical plans explain consistently; materialization records its lineage; QC failures are typed and testable; examples make the magic debuggable rather than opaque.
set.title: Spatial explain, provenance, and QC for lazy plans and evaluations
